facts.fact: UCSF's NAMTAC page says PTracker automatically submits aggregated data to DHIS2 and the National Data Warehouse, and the warehouse combines data from Quantum EPMS, DHIS2 Core and DHIS2 Tracker.
UCSF's NAMTAC page says the national data warehouse takes data from three systems (Quantum EPMS, DHIS2 Core, DHIS2 Tracker), and an OpenHIM-based health information exchange was developed.
